movement.notes: Player faces the direction of last movement input. Use the matching pilgrim_<facing> sprite. left is the mirrored right sheet if you prefer, but pilgrim_left.png is already provided.

divergence.description: Core meter. Represents how far the timeline has branched from the sanctioned path. Drives enemy pressure, room corruption, and the Warden.

thresholds.name: watched
thresholds.effect: A Guardian Angel warning flashes. Rifts begin to shimmer (rift anim speeds up).

thresholds.name: hunted
thresholds.effect: A Variant spawns from the nearest rift and begins tracking the player.

thresholds.name: corrupting
thresholds.effect: The current room begins corrupting: floor tiles decay 1 per 2s, some exits may seal.

thresholds.name: pulled
thresholds.effect: The player is pulled into the branch: teleported to the room's mirror/branch layout or game-over depending on room config.

forbidden_actions.description: Actions that branch the timeline. Each adds divergence and may trigger consequences. Rooms mark which of these are 'forbidden' in that room via room.forbidden list; an action not listed as forbidden in a room is sanctioned and free.

catalog.desc: Attacking a non-hostile figure (a kneeling Fallen, a bound soul).
Taking a relic marked as sealed (chest with a cross seal).
Stepping into an active rift. Travels you into the branch room.
Forcing a door you were meant to leave shut.
Re-entering a room the sanctioned path had you leave.
Leaving a room past an unlit altar you were meant to light.

consequences.spawn_variant: Instantiate an entity of type 'variant' at the nearest rift or the player's position 3 seconds ago. See entities.variant.
consequences.corrupt_room: Begin room corruption immediately regardless of divergence threshold (see divergence.thresholds corrupting effect).
consequences.branch_travel: Load room.branch_of target if present; the branch is a darker mirror with stronger enemies and a relic reward. Leaving via the same rift returns you but keeps accrued divergence.

altar_prayer.trigger: Stand on an altar tile and hold Interact for 1.0s.
effects: Create a checkpoint (save player position + room + inventory).
Seal any active rift in the room (rift becomes inert).
Despawn Variants currently hunting the player.
altar_prayer.cost: An altar can be prayed at once per visit; it goes dim (use altar sprite tinted darker) until the player leaves and returns.

light_cross.effect: Reveals the sanctioned path hint for the room (highlights the intended exit/target) and reduces divergence by 10.

player_attack.name: staff_strike
player_attack.note: Striking a HOSTILE enemy is sanctioned. Striking a NON-hostile figure triggers forbidden_action strike_unarmed.

win_condition: Reach the Sanctum room with divergence below 50 and the three sealed relics NOT stolen (or stolen, for the 'branch' ending). Multiple endings keyed on final divergence and relics taken.

endings.requires: reach Sanctum, divergence < 25, no sealed relics taken
endings.desc: The Warden bows. The Pilgrim ascends.

endings.requires: divergence reaches 100 anywhere OR reach Sanctum with all sealed relics taken
endings.desc: The Pilgrim becomes a Variant. The dungeon keeps them.
